mankey-close-combat.name: Close Combat
mankey-close-combat.description: Bond skill: an all-out flurry of blows on a foe (Power 105, Attack).

mankey-fury-swipes.name: Fury Swipes
mankey-fury-swipes.description: Bond skill: a frenzy of scratches (Power 70, Attack) that leaves the foe Exposed 1 turn.

mankey-bulk-up.name: Bulk Up
mankey-bulk-up.description: Bond skill: tenses its muscles; it is Fortified and Focused for 2 turns.

mankey-vital-spirit.name: Vital Spirit
mankey-vital-spirit.description: Cannot be put to Sleep; heals 3% of max HP at the start of each turn.

mankey-defiant.name: Defiant
mankey-defiant.description: Deals 20% more damage while 2+ foes stand next to it.

mankey-low-sweep.name: Low Sweep
mankey-low-sweep.description: New skill: a sweeping kick at the legs (Power 55) that Slows the foe for 2 turns.

mankey-seismic-toss.name: Seismic Toss
mankey-seismic-toss.description: New skill: grabs a foe and hurls it 2 hexes (Power 55).

mankey-pent-up-fury.name: Pent-Up Fury
mankey-pent-up-fury.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

mankey-relentless-fists.name: Relentless Fists
mankey-relentless-fists.description: Deals 8% more damage per consecutive hit on the same foe (up to 3).

mankey-thrash.name: Thrash
mankey-thrash.description: New skill: thrashes about wildly, hitting every foe next to it (Power 70).

mankey-focus-energy.name: Focus Energy
mankey-focus-energy.description: New skill: pumps itself up and becomes Focused for 2 turns.

mankey-brawler.name: Brawler
mankey-brawler.description: Its Fighting flank bonus is 10% higher.

mankey-shrug-off.name: Shrug It Off
mankey-shrug-off.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

mankey-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
mankey-double-edge.description: New skill: a reckless full-body charge at a foe (Power 95).

mankey-screech.name: Screech
mankey-screech.description: New skill: an ear-splitting screech leaves adjacent foes Exposed for 2 turns.

mankey-rampage.name: Rampage
mankey-rampage.description: Gains 1 Attack for the battle each time it knocks out a foe (max +3).

mankey-hit-and-run.name: Hit and Run
mankey-hit-and-run.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

mankey-focus-punch.name: Focus Punch
mankey-focus-punch.description: New skill: a punch thrown with total focus (Power 100).

mankey-circle-throw.name: Circle Throw
mankey-circle-throw.description: New skill: hurls a foe (Power 75), throwing it 2 hexes away.

mankey-furious-frenzy.name: Furious Frenzy
mankey-furious-frenzy.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

mankey-gang-up.name: Gang Up
mankey-gang-up.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

mankey-rage-incarnate.name: Rage Incarnate
mankey-rage-incarnate.description: Capstone. +20% damage while it carries a status; a knockout resets its skill cooldowns.

mankey-vengeful-pursuit.name: Vengeful Pursuit
mankey-vengeful-pursuit.description: Capstone. Its Fighting moves deal 20% more; its free strikes on fleeing foes deal 30% more.
